name: Ceinwen

attributes.attribute: the Welsh form of St Keyne
name may mean beautiful and fair

text: Ceinwen is a Welsh form of the name St Keyne. The name may join the element coin, which means beautiful, with the element gwen, which means fair. The combination of those two elements gives the Welsh form its sense.

okr.objective: Record Ceinwen as the Welsh form of St Keyne with the possible sense beautiful and fair.
